name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya Sharma's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While studying mechanical engineering at IIT Delhi, a university-organized Formula Student competition ignited her passion. She quickly rose through the ranks, contributing to various racing teams across India and Southeast Asia before PEX Motorsport recognized her talent and recruited her. 

Priya's approach to engineering is deeply rooted in data analysis and meticulous planning. She believes in empowering her team, fostering open communication, and encouraging experimentation. She's known for her ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues under pressure, often finding innovative solutions where others see dead ends.

What sets Priya apart is her dedication to nurturing young talent. She actively mentors junior engineers, ensuring they receive the practical experience and guidance needed to excel in the demanding world of motorsport. Her calm demeanor and ability to explain complex concepts simply makes her a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly tied back in a low ponytail with a few stray strands framing her face.
physical.description: Priya has a warm, intelligent face with a determined set to her jaw.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every race day with a cup of strong masala chai.
